import urllib.request,urllib.error,json,pathlib
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com'
paths=['/saas/console/','/saas/console/login','/saas/console/register','/saas/console/register?type=reseller','/saas/console/forgot-password','/saas/console/reset-password?token=bad','/login','/register','/forgot-password']
out=[]
for p in paths:
  try:
    r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+p,headers={'User-Agent':'OnTrackAuthDiagnose/1.0'}),timeout=6)
    body=r.read(1500).decode('utf-8','replace');out.append({'path':p,'status':r.status,'body':body[:200].replace('\n',' ')})
  except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    body=e.read(2500).decode('utf-8','replace')
    out.append({'path':p,'status':e.code,'location':e.headers.get('Location',''),'body':body[:400].replace('\n',' ')})
  except Exception as e:out.append({'path':p,'error':type(e).__name__})
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/public_html')
print(json.dumps({'routes':out,'live_root_index':(root/'index.php').is_file(),'live_root_htaccess':(root/'.htaccess').is_file(),'nested_console_index':(root/'saas/console/index.php').is_file()},ensure_ascii=False))
